actions.text: Referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committee on Rules, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

dimensions.assessment: Affects the 13 appointed commission members, congressional staff, and indirectly all participants in federal Social Security programs through future recommendations.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall be composed of 13 members.

dimensions.assessment: Creates a formal mechanism to develop long-term solvency proposals with expedited legislative review rules.
dimensions.evidence: transmit to Congress a special message that includes recommendations and proposed legislation for achieving solvency in each of the Federal Old-Age and Survivors Insurance Trust Fund

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of not more than $2,000,000 to carry out the Act.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated not more than $2,000,000 to carry out this Act.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a temporary legislative commission and unique statutory rules for expedited congressional consideration of its legislative proposals.
dimensions.evidence: There is established in the legislative branch a commission to be known as the 'Commission on Long-Term Social Security Solvency'

dimensions.assessment: Temporary duration; the commission terminates not later than 60 days after submitting its report.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall terminate not later than 60 days after the submission of the report described in section 3.

missing_information: Actual final appropriated amounts if differing from the authorized ceiling.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a temporary legislative branch commission on Social Security solvency with specific reporting requirements and expedited congressional consideration rules, backed by an authorization of up to $2,000,000.
